filesChanged: docs/kubernetes.md — the invented cause dropped, the conditional dropped, the 17 GiB marked as this branch's own workspace under an intermediate layout, both figures timestamped, and the operator's manual remedy added.
trickyParts: Go module cache files are written read-only, so a module cache needs `chmod -R u+w` before `rm -rf` will take it; the first pass left thermo7/mod behind for that reason.
discoveredComplexity: Both of the sentences corrected tonight were written to make an argument stronger rather than to describe the system — an imported figure that sharpened a finding, and a cause that made this change sound safer. Neither author checked, because each was improving the case. The sentence that makes the argument stronger is the one to re-derive first.

Every claim in that paragraph about a deployed volume is an inference from this branch's own box, and two in a row were wrong. A claim about production written by roles with no production read should name what it rests on: the 2.1 to 2.7 GiB cites measured live volumes; the cause cited nothing, which is the discriminator a reader can apply.
